title: heimdal.observation.corrected payload (v1, contract-stub)
description: CONTRACT-STUB (Epic #3019 slice A4, #3041; FABLE_COMPANION §3.5, §11#3): schema-representable now, no runtime fold logic lands with this slice (fold logic deferred to §11#12/§11#14). Shape per §3.5: { supersedes, corrects, replacement, basis, actor }. Corrections are new published events carrying supersedes -- the schema forbids in-place edits (HEIM-1); this is a NEW event, never a mutation of the corrected observation_id.

supersedes.description: The observation_id being corrected (§1.3 identity, §3.5). References a prior observation -- never edits it (HEIM-1).

corrects.description: What is being corrected within the superseded observation: 'mention_id' | 'attribution_id' | 'time' | 'consent' (§3.5), or the concrete id of the corrected fragment.

replacement.description: The replacement value, in the same shape as the corrected fragment (§3.5).

basis.description: How the correction was made -- 'stated' human corrections are the strongest evidence in the system (§3.5 rule 1).

actor.description: Who/what performed the correction (operator identity or automated stage).
